lessons: Nov 20: Theo's morning bonus (a short 'real life' moment, 6 AM gym) got the first shares on any account (2). Try more small in-between moments.

Nov 20: votes are near zero on every account (Theo 2, Malik 0, Rosie 0, Horde 0 hauls). Test stronger, easier vote asks (fewer options, a clear 'comment 1 or 2' A/B) and see which account's wording gets more comments.
Nov 20 (1h data): new retention format lowered skip rate on every account that used it (Theo 55.8%->45.6%, Malik 66.3%->48.8%, Horde 58%->53.1%). Keep it everywhere.
Nov 20: only Theo has followers (21). Stories/images/carousels reach ~nobody yet; growth = Reels to non-followers.
Nov 20 analysis: viewers leave during the stats panel/scoreboard at 9-17 s; the vote (29-39 s) is almost never seen. Use template v3 (20-28 s, vote by 18 s).
Nov 20 analysis: hooks that start with 'Day N: you voted' lose ~50-70% in 3 s. Open on the most dramatic beat.

Nov 21 AM extras: Horde fact #1 (v3, 27 s) 114 views / 0 engagement after ~10 h vs battle Reels 108-156 views: same reach, no comments either way. Kept fact format this slot; Horde still needs its first comment of any kind (try a 1-word comment ask, e.g. 'comment your city' with no haul needed, in the midday run). Theo bonus: kept the single-moment format (best % watched + only shares), 27 s, vote by 18 s.

Nov 21 midday extras: Horde fact #3 had only 3 views ~30 min after posting while battle D3 (posted 13 min later) had 85 and fact #2 181 -> possibly two Horde Reels 13 min apart split/suppressed distribution; keep 60+ min between Horde Reels. Still 0 comments of any kind on 7 Horde posts; tested the lowest-barrier ask yet ('just comment your city', no cleanup needed) in a new 60-second-challenge format. Compare its comments/views vs fact and battle Reels next run.

Nov 21: @30daystofix (2-10M views) = PREVIOUSLY montage hook, a joke sticker every 1.5-2 s, live text-chat scenes, a new scene + visibly changed character every day, result-titled covers, 88 s long. Template v4 + scenes2.py added. Visible character change needs live sessions (Leonardo).

Nov 21 (full Day 21 of @30daystofix, ~100 s, transcribed): opens with the audience ask ('57,000 of you asked for better communication skills') + top comment card; then 3 escalating lessons each ending in a fail gag ('Nobody will partner with James so he gets the mannequin. He tells her she has nice joints. Her arm falls off.'), a running callback (coach's sunglasses: 1 pair -> 2 pairs -> takes both off), a real-world test (neighbor talks 40 min, moves her laundry 1 machine closer), payoff in a chat with the ex (she sends 3 paragraphs, 'he reads every word twice'), a stamp gag (certificate: ATTENDED), and ends 'Now it's on you. The top comment picks what James fixes next.' + a heart line. Voting = open TOP COMMENT, not numbered options.

Theo 41-42%, Malik 52%, Rosie 56%, Horde 49-67%. Bring Jess's hook shape (concrete absurd situation + the ex's text, 'still wearing his hoodie') to every account; consider redrawing Malik/Rosie with toon.py at a live session.
